scope: One adapter-authored AC1027 FIELD object referenced by one TABLECONTENT type-2 value.

outputAndReadback.fieldIdentityGate: The low-level writer records only successfully written FIELD source identities for type-2 closure; the adapter profile additionally rejects non-default FIELD state.
outputAndReadback.physicalOutput: The FIELD object is checked to precede its TABLECONTENT consumer; its AcDbField evaluator/code, empty dependency counts, type-4 string value, and terminators are checked in order. The TABLECONTENT content span checks type 2, group 340 = 1740, zero attributes, and the content terminator.
outputAndReadback.typedReadback: FIELD handle/evaluator/code/value and TABLECONTENT handle/type-2 target resolve to the same remapped FIELD identity.
outputAndReadback.failureAndRetry: An absent FIELD target and a non-default unqualified FIELD state are each refused while preserving the destination sentinel; correcting the target/state then succeeds with the same adapter.

validation.focusedOutput: Generated DATALINK writer and adapter routes: PASS

limitations: This profile is intentionally limited to one adapter-authored simple FIELD and one direct TABLECONTENT reference. DXF-origin FIELD/FIELDLIST graph replay and more complex FIELD dependency graphs remain refused or unqualified.
The serialized cached string does not prove expression evaluation or native CAD rendering.
Other TABLECONTENT content orderings, TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP dependencies, units, margins, borders and broader schemas remain open.
